seo.title: About LASAN MARINE | Ship Design, R&D & Software
seo.description: Ship design is the discipline at the centre of LASAN MARINE. Our R&D and software work grew from real technical and workflow problems in practice.

fields.headline: Ship design is our core expertise
fields.lead: LASAN MARINE designs newbuilds and conversions, carries out engineering calculations and completes technical documentation for vessels. From problems that arise in that work, we have built R&D and digital solutions for real-world use.

link.label: From real engineering work to R&D and digital solutions

fields.heading: From real engineering work to R&D and digital solutions
fields.content: Our R&D and digital work did not grow apart from its engineering. It comes from problems that need simulation, measurement, data handling or automation during design and project delivery.

items.title: Agree the scope from the start
items.desc: Before work begins, both sides agree the scope, the input data, the deliverables and any missing information.

items.title: Make the basis of calculation clear
items.desc: Assumptions, inputs, methods and results are set out clearly so they are easy to check and compare.

items.title: Stay close to real conditions
items.desc: Each solution is weighed against existing conditions, construction constraints and operating limits, not the drawings alone.

fields.heading: Experience across many regions
fields.note: Our projects span many provinces, vessel types and operating conditions.
